outcome: clinical characteristics (diagnosis, technology dependence, complex chronic conditions)
encounter characteristics (review of systems, pain/mood management, advance care planning, goals of care discussions, medical decision-making)
cohort: 394 pediatric patients receiving outpatient palliative care over a two-year period, with a total of 889 encounters.
finding: Despite differences in the characteristics of patients seen and the palliative interventions provided, health outcomes and quality indicators were similar across in-person and telehealth care delivery methods.
